title: Dragons of Autumn Twilight
author: Margaret Weis and Tracy Hickman
summary: A group of old friends reunites in a tavern after years apart and finds that the old gods are said to be gone, but dragons are back. They set out to find proof and are soon pursued.
readIf: you like a classic party-of-adventurers fantasy with a fun, varied cast and lots of banter.
skipIf: you want literary prose; the style is straightforward and the villains are quite plain.

pairings.reason: The model for a fellowship on a road, with more depth in its history and landscape.
A lighter, shorter quest with a similar cosy, adventurous spirit.
Another dragon-flavoured fantasy for readers who want a young-adult take on quests and bonds.
